    • getLink

      public static String getLink(javax.servlet.jsp.PageContext pageContext, String unparsedLink, String linkBaseKey)
      Returns a link from a link definition (the link property). This link definition may have parameters like %{propertyName} that will be substituted for appropriate values in the page context, request or session.
      Parameters:
      pageContext - The JSP page context
      unparsedLink - The original link code.
      linkBaseKey - The key to the resource that will be prepended as base path for the link
      commandChar - The character use to denote parameter (ie, the % in %{param})
      Returns:
      The link's final url after all substitutions. TODO: See how the parameter interpretation thing matches JSTL

    • getFieldValueFromBean

      public static String getFieldValueFromBean(javax.servlet.jsp.PageContext context, ModelBean bean, String field) throws ModelException
      Get a formatted/converted value from a bean. This is a very important method regarding performance, since it is going to be executed very often.
      Parameters:
      bean - The bean to be shown
      field - The specific field of the bean to be shown. The name format will be "fieldName::outputContentType"
      Returns:
      The field formatted as an adequeate String for the outputContentType.
      Throws:
      ModelException
